subject.title: fix(control-ui): share gateway token scope across loopback hosts

question: Which loopback alias boundary should Control UI token and session storage share for this fix?
rationale: The implementation choice changes which local gateway URLs can reuse a token and selected session, and that is an auth/session boundary rather than a purely mechanical refactor.

options.title: Narrow And Prove Alias Sharing
options.body: Share only the explicitly approved same-machine aliases, avoid broad numeric 127/8 bucketing unless separately approved, and require browser-real or same-origin URL-edit proof before merge.

options.title: Accept Full 127/8 Sharing
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally treat all numeric 127/8 literals as one Control UI storage scope, but that security and compatibility tradeoff should be stated before merge.

options.title: Replace The Stale Branch
options.body: If the current head cannot be updated cleanly, open a narrow replacement that preserves source PR credit and close this PR after the replacement is viable.

recommendation.title: Narrow And Prove Alias Sharing
recommendation.body: Share only the explicitly approved same-machine aliases, avoid broad numeric 127/8 bucketing unless separately approved, and require browser-real or same-origin URL-edit proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision overlaps adjacent gateway token-scope product/security work and settings-scope history tied to this area.
